title: AI Layer
purpose: Routes approved AI requests to configured providers and tracks provider performance.
description: Routes an AI request (text + optional capability) to an AI provider and returns the answer. Providers (Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, Mistral, OpenAI, Pollinations, SerpApi, Serper, Grok, Claude) run inside this add-on; separate agent add-ons can still register with a signed registration (register_key). Remembers which answers best per capability. NOT connected to Discord or any chat. Providers can run in shadow (test) or live mode. No Home Assistant access. Maps no folders.
